newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Los Bronces expansion still under study.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Los Bronces expansion still under study.

text.p: Expansion plans at Los Bronces copper mine still depend on a a feasibility study and basic engineering research, mine owner Disputada de Las Condes said.
Disputada, owned by Exxon Corp, has announced plans to invest $570 million for expansion at the mine in the Aconcagua valley north of Santiago.

The expansion would raise the mine's daily ore treatment capacity to 75,000 tonnes a day from 37,000 currently and would be finished by the year 2000, according to a notice published Monday in the government's daily gazette.
"This initiative is still in the stage of feasibility studies and basic engineering," Disputada stated.

The notice published in the daily gazette, Diario Oficial, related to Disputada's request for environmental permits for the project, said the statement. Such permits are a necessary step of the study process, it said.
